title: Family Group on Porch, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black and white snapshot from the mid-1940s depicting four family members posing on the porch of a suburban home. The group consists of a young woman in a plaid skirt, a tall man wearing a wide tie, and two older women in daytime dresses. The back of the photo features faint handwritten pencil notes and a 365 stamp along the edge.
